exposure: uterine dehiscence vs. no uterine dehiscence
presence of niche in the lower uterine segment
thinning of the lower uterine segments
outcome: morphological changes in the lower uterine segment
cohort: 31 women with a normal singleton pregnancy delivered by elective cesarean section between 2020 and 2021, with all women showing a 'niche' in the lower uterine segments
finding: Thinning of the lower uterine segment, particularly in the second trimester, was associated with uterine scar dehiscence at the time of cesarean section..
